subject: the treasuries of the winds are opened

narration: The old accounts say he was shown the treasuries of all of them.

subject: the treasuries of the winds are opened

narration: And that the earth is founded on them.

subject: the treasuries of the winds are opened

subject: the pillars of heaven are set in place

narration: He walks between two of them and the grit lifts off the ground around his feet.

subject: the pillars of heaven are set in place

narration: Each one turns slowly, and where it turns the dust inside it draws the whole shape.
phenomenon: {windpillars} medium, the flank of one column filling the frame, dense dust spiralling inside it and describing its outline, bright light passing through
subject: the pillars of heaven are set in place

narration: You could put a hand into one. He does not.
phenomenon: {windpillars} extreme close, an open hand held a short distance from a wall of turning air, grit streaming past the fingertips, hard light on the knuckles
subject: the pillars of heaven are set in place

narration: These are the pillars of heaven, and the sky is resting on them right now.
phenomenon: {windpillars} extreme wide high angle, the whole colonnade of air columns seen from above with a bright vault stretched across their tops, {enochman} tiny between two of them
subject: the pillars of heaven are set in place

narration: He looks up and cannot find the top of any of them.
phenomenon: {windpillars} close low angle, an upturned weathered face lit hard from above by bright sky, eyes narrowed, the column edge blurred behind
subject: the pillars of heaven are set in place

narration: Past the pillars the ground stops in a clean straight line.

subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: Not a cliff. Cliffs are broken things. This has been cut.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} close, the cut edge of pale stone seen in profile, the face flat and tooled and square, bright light along the top arris
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: One enormous square block of pale stone, laid, and everything else laid against it.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} extreme wide low angle from beyond the edge, a titanic square-cut foundation block with the whole landmass bedded against it, bright light on its outer face
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: The corner of it goes out over nothing and keeps going.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} medium high angle, the projecting corner of the block running out into bright empty air, its far end lost in light
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: He puts his hand flat on the top of it, the way he did on the glass.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} extreme close, an open palm pressed flat on pale tooled stone, the tool marks sharp under bright raking light
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: The whole world is on the other side of this stone from where he is standing.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} wide from beyond the edge looking back, {enochman} standing small on the block with an entire landmass rising behind him, bright light across it all
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: Somebody set this down first, and then built out from it.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} extreme wide high angle, the foundation block seen from far above with land bedded against two of its faces, bright even light showing the geometry
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: The old accounts call it the cornerstone, and give it one line.
phenomenon: {cornerstone} close, {tablet} laid flat on pale tooled stone with fresh cut lines on its face, bright light held in the grooves
subject: the cornerstone of the earth is uncovered

narration: South of the corner, the ground burns without being consumed.

narration: Day and night, the same, on a plain with nothing on it to feed a fire.

subject: seven mountains of coloured stone rise

narration: Not rock. Stone -- the kind you would set in a ring.

subject: seven mountains of coloured stone rise

subject: seven mountains of coloured stone rise

narration: Each of them is a mountain, and each of them is a single piece.
phenomenon: {sevenmountains} wide low angle, one entire mountain of coloured stone rising from base to summit as a single continuous piece, the surface unbroken and lit warm from the burning ground
subject: seven mountains of coloured stone rise

narration: He counts six, and then looks at the middle of them.
phenomenon: {sevenmountains} medium from behind, {enochman} standing on dark rock with six coloured summits ranged before him, warm light on his back
subject: seven mountains of coloured stone rise

narration: The seventh one is in the centre and it is taller than the six.

subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: White the whole way up, and the light on it does not come from the burning ground.
phenomenon: {thronepeak} wide, the white flank of the central mountain lit from above by a cold source while warm firelight reaches only its base
subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: The shape at the top of it is a seat.
phenomenon: {thronepeak} extreme wide, the summit of the white mountain formed into the clear shape of a great seat, bright cold light standing on it
subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: Not like a seat. A seat -- arms, back, a step in front of it.
phenomenon: {thronepeak} medium, the summit seen closer, arms and a high back and a broad step cut clearly in white stone, hard light along every edge
subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: And the seat is a blue he will describe, later, as the colour of the sky when it is deepest.

subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: There are trees around the base of it, and they smell of something he cannot place.
phenomenon: {thronepeak} wide low angle, heavy dark trees ringing the base of the white mountain, warm light from the plain reaching their lower branches
subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: Nobody is sitting in it.
phenomenon: {thronepeak} extreme wide, the empty seat on the summit against an enormous dark sky, one shaft of cold light falling on it
subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: Uriel walks him past it without stopping, toward a hole in the ground beyond the mountains.

narration: Beyond the seven, the ground gives out.

narration: No sky over it either, which he has trouble explaining afterwards.

subject: the ground gives out beyond the mountains

narration: He stands at the last of the solid ground and looks down into it.

narration: It is a waste. That is the word the old accounts use, and it is the right one.

subject: the ground gives out beyond the mountains

narration: Nothing grows in it, nothing crosses it, nothing has ever wanted to.

subject: the ground gives out beyond the mountains

narration: Uriel says this is the end of heaven and earth.
phenomenon: {wasteplace} medium two-shot, {guideone} and {enochman} standing at the rim in profile, cold light on their faces from behind, the dark ahead of them
subject: the ground gives out beyond the mountains

narration: Which is a strange thing to be shown while you are still standing on it.
phenomenon: {wasteplace} extreme close low angle, two bare feet on the last of the pale rock with the edge a hand's width away, hard light across the stone grain
subject: the ground gives out beyond the mountains

subject: seven stars burn bound in the pit

subject: seven stars burn bound in the pit

narration: There is no sound from any of it, which is the worst part.

subject: seven stars burn bound in the pit

narration: He has seen these from his own roof, at night, for three hundred years.

subject: seven stars burn bound in the pit

subject: the charge is named: they rose late

subject: the charge is named: they rose late

narration: Somewhere below him the fire turns over and one of them moves with it.

subject: the charge is named: they rose late

subject: the charge is named: they rose late

narration: Out here, order is not a preference. It is the floor everything else stands on.
phenomenon: {starprison} extreme wide low angle, the seven stars ranged above the viewpoint in an ordered line against the dark, each one enormous and evenly spaced, their light falling together onto the rock below
subject: the charge is named: they rose late

subject: the charge is named: they rose late

subject: the term is set at ten thousand years

subject: the term is set at ten thousand years

subject: the term is set at ten thousand years

subject: the term is set at ten thousand years

narration: There is a second place, further on, and Uriel takes him to it.
